subject: Make sure standard library is imported when using abort (#395)
reason: The change only adds #include <stdlib.h> to the fallback branch of the valkey_unreachable macro in src/config.h, taken solely on compilers older than GCC 4.5 that lack __builtin_unreachable. It is a build/portability fix with no runtime behavior change: on any build the fuzzer can run, the fallback branch is not compiled at all, so no command, replication, persistence or cluster path is affected and no scenario can reach it.
